label: Finite models separating reflexive distinct-nonmutual dependence from asymmetry (inference)
meaning: The identity relation on two beings, and the two-element order in which true depends on false, are reflexive and nonmutual on distinct beings but not asymmetric; the second is also transitive and has a distinct edge. This shows only that STMT-DISTINCT-BEINGS-NOT-MUTUALLY-DEPENDENT and STMT-DEPENDENCE-FOR-BEING-ASYMMETRIC differ in meaning on the diagonal; it is not a metaphysical claim about self-dependence.
